kind: new temporal-code integer student, finite-resource CPU service schedule; no RTL/PPA claim
boundary: Complete T10 source-PSN decisions are ready, then fixed-cost K8 encoder, FC1/basis accumulation, full T10 PSN and original integer threshold, theta-g output. Source PSN production is outside all routes.
data: algorithm/temporal_codes; untrained_code8 and trained_code8, ten existing full P19200 captures each; train32-only dictionary

routes.direct_T10_zero_skip: Ten wide slots; drop contributions from known zero source rows, including t8/t9. Original Aq and original tau.
routes.folded_time_rows: Seven wide slots. Group identical dictionary time rows: [0],[1,4],[2],[3],[5],[6],[7]. Add corresponding Aq columns; omit zero t8/t9. Original tau is retained, including all BN offsets.
routes.code_basis_B: Seven wide slots for nonzero code membership. S[k,h]=sum_c onehot(code)[k]*Wq[h,c]; use compiled B=Aq*D. Original tau retained.

common_coefficient_pool.cold_payloads: W, original 48bit tau, A/Afold/B16, dictionary, zero-state output template and theta/context

wide_state_ports: 96 lane banks, one vector read and one vector write per beat, forwarding for consecutive FC1 updates; slot count is the only difference between route1 and routes2/3

source_encoder.raw_packet_payload: 120 bytes for10x96 source decisions, plus8 bytes theta/context
source_encoder.note: Raw input signatures were not captured. Every channel pays all8 candidates; do not infer raw silence from projected zero. A source-PSN producer must supply complete-position packets; converting an unrelated stored layout is not assumed free.

source_mask_ports: One masked row write and one320bit column read per beat. Each six-channel encoding result writes at most8 active time rows, or7 folded/code rows, serially during the next8 candidate steps; the last write tail is fully charged. Both mask buffers fit the same7.5KiB register array.
broadcast_and_queue: Actual source-column order; one96-byte W vector per nonempty column and h block is broadcast to all consumers in the B32 tile. Reuse existing support_service_model.schedule_fc1: bounded384-byte/four-entry prefetch, physical16-byte word bank mapping, one return/word/bank/beat. First vector contribution assigns; later contributions add.
pipeline: All routes have two source mask buffers. Next tile encoding starts with current tile compute. Exact128-byte source requests through two raw-packet buffers arbitrate against scheduled output packets; PSN and FC1 share96 issue lanes. No full-frame source or output cache.
limits: Model service beats and internal byte counts, not silicon cycles, frequency or energy. Foundry28nm memories/RF ports are unimplemented. No100-to70 or three-slot reduction is credited uniquely to route3; main comparison is route3 versus route2 on the same student.
